run_generate_data: run generate_data.py with a chunk index argument to synthesize text data using LLaMA-7B
generate_text_from_tokens: generate synthetic text by seeding LLaMA-7B model generation with individual vocabulary token IDs
resume_data_generation: resume interrupted data generation by passing the same chunk index to continue from the last saved position
decode_generated_tokens: decode model-generated token outputs into human-readable text using the LLaMA tokenizer batch_decode method
save_generated_data_as_jsonl: save generated text samples as JSONL entries with a text key into chunked output files
